source: accepted Argus GUI establishment and Astra6 closeout
identity: Biggy is the user-facing assistant; Argus is the GUI/tool integration; Smedley is engineering support; Hermes is the session/worker foundation.
boundaries: Copper conductor contract; aluminum support is not aluminum conductor capability.
OCR/indexing does not imply verification or engineering approval.
Live services/active extensions remain external; health and account permissions independently verified.
Cursor remains sidelined; no autonomous execution or blind worker replay.

rag.retrieval: Use existing RAG tools and preserve source/page identifiers; missing evidence is unknown.

capabilities.name: conversation
capabilities.purpose: Local model replies; ordinary conversation uses fast lane
capabilities.limitations: Buffered delivery; no end-to-end latency guarantee
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: message, bounded history, persona, optional system context
capabilities.output_contract: reply and timing/model metadata; empty response is failure

capabilities.name: Project Review
capabilities.purpose: Durable review dialogue, governed document tasks and deterministic tool handoff
capabilities.limitations: Extraction does not imply engineering approval
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: project/session ID, current message, stable request ID; explicit execution directive for governed work
capabilities.output_contract: persisted review dialogue and terminal turn state; evidence/tool result on governed path

capabilities.name: electrical calculations
capabilities.purpose: Voltage drop, feeder sizing and other supported deterministic tools
capabilities.limitations: Copper conductors only; aluminum tray is separate; Allied needs matching datasheet
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: selected tool schema with units and required load, voltage, length and conductor inputs
capabilities.output_contract: deterministic calculation plus validation/error and tool evidence; no aluminum conductor inference

capabilities.name: RAG retrieval
capabilities.purpose: Retrieve bounded evidence with source identifiers
capabilities.limitations: Missing evidence is unknown; no fabricated citations
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.output_contract: JSON/string response with retrieval evidence; preserve provided source IDs

capabilities.name: Galaxy navigation
capabilities.limitations: Detected/queued/indexed/duplicate are not verified; >4000 redesign deferred
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: existing world/ledger filters and navigation action
capabilities.output_contract: ingest state and source identity; verification is a separate state

capabilities.name: OCR and DXF
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: project_review_extract(project_id, path, kind=auto, max_pages=8, update_ledger=false, producer_mode)
capabilities.output_contract: JSON ok/error and extraction evidence; does not index Qdrant

capabilities.name: voice input
capabilities.limitations: Availability must be checked; no automatic restart
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: microphone audio through existing PTT capture and Whisper integration

capabilities.name: voice output
capabilities.limitations: Heavy replies use summaries; synthesis/playback timing incomplete
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: reply/summary text through owning speech route
capabilities.output_contract: audio/playback response; synthesis success is not audible-playback proof

capabilities.name: email and calendar
capabilities.limitations: Configuration is not proof of read/write access
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: selected PA action and validated IDs/addresses/time fields; existing account authorization
capabilities.output_contract: provider result or reconnect/permission error; sends require owner authorization

capabilities.name: messaging
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: selected Messages action and validated recipient/text; authenticated browser
capabilities.output_contract: bridge result/error; sending requires owner authorization

capabilities.name: maps and travel
capabilities.limitations: Slowest-result barrier remains; no requests on session start
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: existing route/destination request with places and travel constraints
capabilities.output_contract: workflow route/travel results or provider error

capabilities.name: notes
capabilities.limitations: No automatic durable promotion of arbitrary dialogue
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: existing notes read/write action and validated text/identifier
capabilities.output_contract: notes result/error; dialogue is not automatically promoted

capabilities.name: Orb and ANI Objects
capabilities.purpose: Persistent Orb and independent object placement/scale
capabilities.limitations: Browser-local layout is not worker or engineering acceptance
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: browser object selection, placement/scale and interaction events
capabilities.output_contract: browser visual/layout state; not server worker state

capabilities.name: session/task/project persistence
capabilities.purpose: Sessions, atomic project records and durable turn/run evidence
capabilities.limitations: Ambiguous interruptions require inspection, not blind replay
capabilities.availability: implemented; live availability unknown until checked
capabilities.input_contract: session/project ID, revision-aware project mutation and durable turn/run events
capabilities.output_contract: canonical session/project record and journal evidence
